labels.rationale: Wrong project: asks to change select(), which Rich does not define (check_api lists it as missing).

body:
Rich does not have a `select()` function, so this request is for a different library. The keyboard-driven `select()` with Up/Down navigation comes from that library, and filtering options by typing needs to be requested there. Rich's own prompt helpers are documented at https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/prompt.rst

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
